Name: Junimo Box Set (OUTDATED)
Author: MintTeax21
Description:
[ 1/15/21 ]

If you experience any issues, please download the newest version of Expanded Storage!


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Hello!

A few days ago, I heard that the 1.5 updates came out, so I downloaded Stardew Valley again for the first time in forever.

While I was searching for portraits and mods that are compatible with 1.5, I found a lot of adorable retextures.
I wished to find a way to apply more than one retextures at a time.

Thanks to furyx639’s Expanded Storage mod, I was able to create this “Junimo Box Set.”
This mod will add 15 extra storage boxes to your game!






[img]https://i.imgur.com/FBNyG26.png[/img]

Originally, I was thinking about making maybe 4~5 boxes, but I was having so much fun designing and got lost in the process, lol
I couldn’t choose just a few, so I decided to divide the boxes into five categories.

Then, to make it more fun, I set each of the boxes in the same category to have different capacities!

Each box comes with its own sub-folder. So, if you do not wish to cluster your crating tab with boxes, you can just select the ones you like and delete the last of the folders.








[img]https://i.imgur.com/JxUVaZt.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/YRlmEe7.png[/img]

These are the crafting recipes.

I tried to set the required ingredients to match the theme,,, but it was harder than I thought.
I sort of gave up on balancing the difficulty and focused on selecting the ingredients you can access for all season.
But, you are welcome to alter the recipe to your liking.








[img]https://i.imgur.com/uDVMyHM.png[/img]

If you don’t want to craft, you can just search for them using CJBItemSpawner, by typing “junimo” or “box.”




----------------------------------------------------

[b]<<< How to install >>>[/b]

Please download the “expanded Storage” mod and this mod.
Unzip them all and put them in your Stardew Valley\Mods folder.

----------------------------------------------------


[b]!!! Things to Know !!![/b]

1. Expanded Storage mod comes with carrying chest function. If you are using the “CarryChest” mod, I would advise you to delete it because it can cause disappearing item issues. You will still be able to carry all the boxes, including default storage.




2. You don’t see an arrow for a large box? Don’t worry.
    The arrow will appear as the box expands and you will be able to scroll as well.






3. You can change the capacity and the crafting recipe.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rM95BPy.png[/img]

    ‘expandedStorage.json’ from “[ES] Junimo Box Set” : number of slots for each box
    ‘big-craftable.json’ from “[JA] Junimo Box Set” : box crafting recipes

    (To make it easier, I noted the name of the ingredients with // for you ?)






4. I mostly used the base game pixel designs to create this mod.
     I hope it blends well with your farm.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Jxt6WYO.png[/img]

    Unfortunately, due to my poor skills and limitation, you cannot change the box color.





6. Lastly, these are some example screenshots.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/mtVZMst.png[/img]

     I always wanted to decorate my farm with adorable junimos.
     I enjoyed the scrambling trial process to create this mod in hopes to make my farm more alive. 
     Although there were small hiccups along the way, I’m so happy how it turned out. I hope you like it as well.


     Thank you for reading this long post, and please be kind as it’s my first mod.
     I would appreciate any comments, suggestions, and advice.
     Please let me know if you are having issues with this mod, I will try my best to fix it.
